correctness.rationale: The induced-edge clique capacity q_i is proved exactly. Each bin is k-variable definable, finite-color path reachability composes with only k variable symbols, and maximal finite colored distance equals the number of factors in that bin. The converse uses a lasting coordinatewise equality-pattern invariant in the ordinary k-pebble game, with at most k-1 old coordinate values after each lift. Widths one and two, equality, degenerate single-coordinate cases, and strict cutoff boundaries are handled separately. Exact type refinement (10 graph comparisons) and independent clique/diameter evaluation (39 cases) passed; finite checks are corroborative.

value.rationale: A complete infinite-family classification for every finite variable width k gives a sharp hierarchy of alphabet thresholds, exact minimum distinguishing width for arbitrary product pairs, a binomial theory count at each dimension, and smallest representatives. It strictly extends the known three-variable case and is not a single low-depth observation or arbitrary finite slice. The colored-distance mechanism reconstructs entire coordinate multiplicities without counting quantifiers.
